title: NROL-16 on Walpurgisnacht, matching a Necronomicon rite

tellings.quote: The launch itself happened on 12:50 a.m. on April 30th, 2005. This happens to be the same day of Walpurgisnacht,

plain: NROL-16, a classified spy-satellite launch, lifted off at 12:50 a.m. on April 30, 2005, the same date as Walpurgisnacht, the old European witches' night, and the timing is said to match a rite in the Necronomicon, a book of occult spells. Jesse Michels tells this himself, drawing on the work of a researcher named John Ramirez, as a sign that occult ritual runs through the American space program.
